utterances: join clip.mp4 and clip2.mp4 into one video and compress it for email
stitch clip.mp4 and clip2.mp4 together, then shrink the result so it fits in an email
clip.mp4 und clip2.mp4 zusammenfuegen und das Ergebnis fuer E-Mail komprimieren

baseline.command: ffmpeg -y -i clip.mp4 -i clip2.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v]scale=1280:720[v0];[1:v]scale=1280:720[v1];[v0][0:a][v1][1:a]concat=n=2:v=1:a=1[outv][outa]" -map [outv] -map [outa] -c:v libx264 -crf 28 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart merged_compressed.mp4

utterances: cut the first 5 seconds out of clip.mp4 and prepare that piece for WhatsApp
keep only seconds 0 to 5 of clip.mp4, then make it WhatsApp-ready
die ersten 5 Sekunden von clip.mp4 ausschneiden und fuer WhatsApp vorbereiten

baseline.command: ffmpeg -y -ss 00:00:00 -to 00:00:05 -i clip.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart clip_whatsapp.mp4

utterances: make clip.mp4 louder by 6dB and then save its audio as an mp3
boost the volume of clip.mp4 by 6 dB, then rip the sound to mp3
clip.mp4 um 6 dB lauter machen und danach die Tonspur als MP3 speichern
grab a jpeg thumbnail from clip.mp4 at 2 seconds and another one from clip.mov at 3 seconds
I need two stills: clip.mp4 at the 2 second mark and clip.mov at the 3 second mark, both as jpeg
scale clip_4k.mp4 down to 720p, drop the audio and save it as webm
downscale clip_4k.mp4 to 720p, mute it and export as a webm file
clip_4k.mp4 auf 720p verkleinern, den Ton entfernen und als WebM speichern
double the speed of clip.mp4 and keep only the first 3 seconds of the result
speed clip.mp4 up 2x, then trim the sped-up video to its first 3 seconds

baseline.command: ffmpeg -y -i clip.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v]setpts=0.5*PTS[v];[0:a]atempo=2.0[a]" -map [v] -map [a] -t 3 -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart clip_fast_trimmed.mp4

utterances: prepare clip.mov for YouTube and also give me a jpeg poster frame from it at 1 second
make clip.mov YouTube-ready, and separately grab a jpeg of its frame at 1 second

baseline.command: ffmpeg -y -i clip.mov -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart clip_youtube.mp4

outputs.command: ffmpeg -y -i clip.mov -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart clip_youtube.mp4

utterances: turn the volume of clip.mp4 down by 3dB and resize it to 480p
quieten clip.mp4 by 3 dB and scale it down to 480p
clip.mp4 um 3 dB leiser machen und auf 480p skalieren

baseline.command: ffmpeg -y -i clip.mp4 -af volume=-3dB -vf scale=-2:480 -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart clip_quiet_480p.mp4

utterances: convert clip.mov to mp4 and clip2.mp4 to mkv
I need clip.mov as an mp4 and clip2.mp4 as an mkv
clip.mov nach mp4 und clip2.mp4 nach mkv konvertieren

baseline.command: ffmpeg -y -i clip.mov -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart clip_converted.mp4

outputs.command: ffmpeg -y -i clip.mov -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart clip_converted.mp4

utterances: take seconds 2 to 6 of clip.mp4 and play that part backwards
cut clip.mp4 down to the 2s-6s range, then reverse it
die Sekunden 2 bis 6 von clip.mp4 nehmen und rueckwaerts abspielen

baseline.command: ffmpeg -y -ss 00:00:02 -to 00:00:06 -i clip.mp4 -vf reverse -af areverse -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -preset medium -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -movflags +faststart clip_part_reversed.mp4
